visual.name: pnlByDatenWG
visual.description: IBCS-inspired P&L / GuV statement: unbalanced parent-child account hierarchy or level columns, subtotal and formula rows (EBITDA, margins), sign conventions with variance-invert for cost rows, scenarios AC/PY/PL/FC with delta bars and delta-percent pins, k/m scaling and a 3-line IBCS title block. Views: table with the IBCS mega table (templates T01–T04, 12A, 12G and 12H: value and variance columns, bars, pins, integrated variance waterfalls, value cascades incl. YTD + rest-of-year stacks, plan statements with tinted variances, month | YTD | FY blocks, thresholds, headline slot, scale sync across visuals, virtualized long statements), structure bars, row waterfall and a value driver tree (DuPont or dimension hierarchy) with card zoom, re-root and breadcrumb. Selection, cross-filtering, drillthrough and the native context menu. Finance conventions from ChartKitchen: tooltips, sum-safe rounding, parentheses for negatives, house terms for the scenarios, materiality, highlight rows, blue / orange variance preset. Smart Start demo statement while no fields are bound, light / dark appearance that follows the report theme, and a localized UI in German, English, Spanish and Japanese.
